# Jido Composer v0.6.1 - Table of Contents

## Modules

- [Jido.Composer.ApprovalGate](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.ApprovalGate.md): Typed sub-state for tracking approval gates in the Orchestrator.
- [Jido.Composer.Children](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Children.md): Typed sub-state for tracking child agent references and their lifecycle phases.
- [Jido.Composer.FanOut.State](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.FanOut.State.md): Typed sub-state for tracking FanOut branch execution.
- [Jido.Composer.OtelCtx](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.OtelCtx.md): Centralized OpenTelemetry context management for jido_composer.
- [Jido.Composer.Skill](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Skill.md): Reusable capability bundle for runtime agent assembly.
- [Jido.Composer.ToolConcurrency](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.ToolConcurrency.md): Typed sub-state for tracking tool call concurrency in the Orchestrator.
- [Jido.Composer.HITL.ChildRef](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.HITL.ChildRef.md): Backward-compatible alias for `Jido.Composer.ChildRef`.
- [Jido.Composer.Node.DynamicAgentNode](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.DynamicAgentNode.md): Node that assembles and executes a sub-agent from selected skills at runtime.
- [Jido.Composer.Node.MapNode](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.MapNode.md): Applies the same node to each element of a runtime-determined list.
- [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.Obs](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.Obs.md): Observability state and span lifecycle for orchestrator strategies.
- [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.StatusComputer](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.StatusComputer.md): Computes orchestrator status from sub-state modules.
- [Jido.Composer.Workflow.Obs](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Workflow.Obs.md): Observability state and span lifecycle for workflow strategies.

- Core
  - [Jido.Composer](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.md): Composable agent topologies for the Jido ecosystem.
  - [Jido.Composer.Context](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Context.md): Layered context struct separating ambient (read-only), working (mutable),
and fork functions (applied at agent boundaries).
  - [Jido.Composer.Error](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Error.md): Structured error types for Jido Composer using Splode.
  - [Jido.Composer.Node](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.md): Uniform context-in/context-out interface for workflow participants.
  - [Jido.Composer.NodeIO](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.NodeIO.md): Typed envelope for node output.

- Workflow
  - [Jido.Composer.Workflow](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Workflow.md): Deterministic FSM workflow DSL.
  - [Jido.Composer.Workflow.DSL](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Workflow.DSL.md): Compile-time macro for declarative workflow agent definitions.
  - [Jido.Composer.Workflow.Machine](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Workflow.Machine.md): Pure FSM struct at the heart of a Workflow.
  - [Jido.Composer.Workflow.Strategy](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Workflow.Strategy.md): Jido.Agent.Strategy implementation for deterministic FSM-based workflows.

- Orchestrator
  - [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.md): LLM-driven orchestrator DSL.
  - [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.AgentTool](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.AgentTool.md): Converts Nodes into ReqLLM Tool structs for LLM function calling.
  - [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.Configure](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.Configure.md): Runtime configuration API for orchestrator agents.
  - [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.DSL](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.DSL.md): Compile-time macro for declarative orchestrator agent definitions.
  - [Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.Strategy](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Orchestrator.Strategy.md): Jido.Agent.Strategy implementation for LLM-driven orchestration.

- Nodes
  - [Jido.Composer.Node.ActionNode](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.ActionNode.md): Wraps a `Jido.Action` module as a Node.
  - [Jido.Composer.Node.AgentNode](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.AgentNode.md): Wraps a `Jido.Agent` module as a Node.
  - [Jido.Composer.Node.FanOutNode](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.FanOutNode.md): Executes multiple child nodes concurrently and merges their results.
  - [Jido.Composer.Node.HumanNode](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Node.HumanNode.md): A Node representing a point where a human must provide input.

- Suspension &amp; HITL
  - [Jido.Composer.Checkpoint](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Checkpoint.md): Checkpoint preparation and restore for Composer strategy state.
  - [Jido.Composer.ChildRef](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.ChildRef.md): Serializable reference to a child agent process.
  - [Jido.Composer.Resume](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Resume.md): External-facing API for resuming suspended agents.
  - [Jido.Composer.Suspension](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Suspension.md): Generalized suspension metadata for any reason a flow might pause.
  - [Jido.Composer.HITL.ApprovalRequest](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.HITL.ApprovalRequest.md): A serializable struct representing a pending human decision.
  - [Jido.Composer.HITL.ApprovalResponse](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.HITL.ApprovalResponse.md): The human's response to an `ApprovalRequest`.

- Directives
  - [Jido.Composer.Directive.CheckpointAndStop](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Directive.CheckpointAndStop.md): Directive for hibernating a child agent and signaling the parent.
  - [Jido.Composer.Directive.FanOutBranch](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Directive.FanOutBranch.md): Directive emitted per-branch when the Workflow strategy encounters a FanOutNode
or MapNode.
  - [Jido.Composer.Directive.Suspend](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Directive.Suspend.md): Generalized suspend directive emitted by strategies when a flow suspends.
  - [Jido.Composer.Directive.SuspendForHuman](https://jido-composer.hexdocs.pm/Jido.Composer.Directive.SuspendForHuman.md): Convenience wrapper that builds a generalized `Suspend` directive
with `reason: :human_input` and an embedded `ApprovalRequest`.
